source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?released ?dirLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item ?sitelinks (SAMPLE(?d) AS ?dir) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?d) AS ?nD) (GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(COALESCE(STR(?pubT), ""), "|", COALESCE(STR(?pubP), "")); separator=";") AS ?released) WHERE { ?item wdt:P136 wd:Q28026639 ; wdt:P31 wd:Q11424 ; wdt:P57 ?d ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . FILTER(?sitelinks >= 20) OPTIONAL { ?item p:P577 ?pubSt . ?pubSt a wikibase:BestRank ; psv:P577 [ wikibase:timeValue ?pubT ; wikibase:timePrecision ?pubP ] . } } GROUP BY ?item ?sitelinks } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nD = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 160
